hero.title: Kinomori
hero.tagline: Asia meets Morocco in every bite

about.title: Our Story
about.origin_text: Where the Atlas Mountains meet the Atlantic, Kinomori was born from a friendship between Moroccan and Chinese families united by a love of good food.
about.philosophy_text: Chinese culinary precision, Moroccan hospitality. Every dish honors both traditions.
about.chef_quote: Cooking is how I say I love you without words.

reviews.title: What People Say
reviews.r1: Best sushi in the Taghazout area! Fresh, flavorful, and beautiful presentation.
reviews.r2: The ramen is absolutely incredible — real Tonkotsu, you can taste the hours of broth.
reviews.r3: Kinomori feels like home. The atmosphere, the food, the people. Unmissable.
